name: cap methyltransferase 2

function.text: CMTR2 encodes cap-specific mRNA (nucleoside-2'-O-)-methyltransferase 2. Annotated molecular activities include methyltransferase cap1 activity and methyltransferase cap2 activity. It participates in 7-methylguanosine mRNA capping.
